subject: Mid-quarter trajectory signal & dependency action request
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Greenwave Analytics <cteam@greenwave.ai>, Greenwave Procurement <procurement@greenwave.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter trajectory signal & dependency action request

Team / Greenwave,

Heading into the mid-quarter readout I wanted to surface a brief, focused signal on two production-facing OKRs that are at risk and outline very specific dependency asks. TL;DR: we need a 2-week infra commit + procurement PO + one security artifact to avoid a meaningful delivery slip for Greenwave pilot launch.

OKR snapshot (current -> target):
- Inference cost per 1M tokens: 26% -> target 22% (progress: 55% complete, high cost-sensitivity)
- Chat API p95 end-to-end latency: 240ms -> target <200ms (progress: 40% complete, latency blocker)

Why this matters now:
- Greenwave's pilot is scheduled to start ingesting customer traffic 8/18; our current cost and latency numbers will materially impact their SRE acceptance and renewal conversation.
- The Dedicated pool tuning we planned needs an aligned infra window to validate batching changes and a fallback routing policy.

Asks (clear owners & dates):
1) Infra reserve: 2x A100-equivalent node-hours reserved in the Dedicated pool (engineering commit from infra) for the week of 7/26 — owner: Karthik — please confirm by 7/21 EOD.
2) Procurement: Greenwave PO for reserved capacity (initial 3-month) — owner: Greenwave Procurement — target signature by 7/28. Attachment: gwave_procurement_packet.docx.
3) Security/compliance: one-off SOC-concordance artifact (data flow diagram + retention table) to satisfy Greenwave legal — owner: Rafael / Tessa to coordinate with Security — deliverable due 7/23.
4) Latency unblock: narrow p95 culprit to one of the three suspects (KV-cache pressure / kernel choice / network egress) — owner: Karthik — ETA 7/24 with Jira ticket.

Attached is a short readout deck (midq_okr_readout.pdf) and the current latency export (latency_benchmarks_q2.csv). I will run a 10-minute sync on Tuesday (7/21) at 9:30 PT — invite to follow.

Greenwave team: if any of these timelines are aggressive on your side, call it out now and we will re-plan. Specifically procurement: if you need a revised PO template or a walk-through, Rafael and Tessa can jump on a short call.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenwave Analytics <cteam@greenwave.ai>, Greenwave Procurement <procurement@greenwave.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter trajectory signal & dependency action request

Rafael — thanks for the concise signal. I read the deck and agree with the prioritization. Quick notes: 

- Procurement: we can provide a short PO checklist and a single-point billing contact. Rafael/Tessa — I can loop in Finance Ops if Greenwave needs net-30 vs net-45.
- Infra reserve: I can commit a burst window from the infra budget for 7/26-8/01 if Karthik confirms the exact GPU profile and hours.
- Security artifact: Tessa, happy to own the initial redline of the data flow diagram; Rafael, please send the minimal retention table you want included (columns: field, retention, justification).

Karthik — can you confirm the suspected p95 root causes and whether the Dedicated pool change requires a model recompile or just runtime config? If a recompile is needed it likely adds 3 business days for validation.

Laura

Quick technical update and commitments:

- Initial signal: the p95 delta is primarily driven by KV-cache churn under 2x concurrent sessions and one kernel fallback path that triggers at sequence lengths > 1,024. I opened INF-4823 with the profiling summary.
- Recompile vs config: we can avoid a full model recompile initially by changing runtime kernel selection and increasing the KV cache shard retention; that is a runtime config change but requires the infra reserve window for end-to-end validation (no model artifact churn). Estimated validation time: 48-72 hours.
- Action: I will schedule the validation during the 7/26 reserved window and post progress to the Jira.

Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4823
Committed owner: Karthik Iyer (will update with exact node-hours by EOD 7/21).
